title: SQL Injection Login Bypass
impact: An attacker can log in as the administrator without knowing the password and gain full administrative access.
remediation: Use parameterized queries or an ORM so user input is never concatenated into SQL statements.

title: UNION-based SQL Injection in Product Search
impact: An attacker can extract user records including email addresses and password hashes from the database.
remediation: Use parameterized queries for search and apply least-privilege database permissions.

title: Reflected XSS in Search
impact: An attacker can execute arbitrary JavaScript in a victim's browser through a crafted search link.
remediation: Contextually encode output, avoid inserting user input into innerHTML, and use a strict Content Security Policy.

title: Stored XSS via Customer Feedback
impact: A submitted payload is stored in the database and executes for every visitor who views the About page.
remediation: Sanitize and encode stored input before rendering it, use a trusted HTML sanitizer, and apply Content Security Policy.
